verdict.rationale: Discord's webhooks (discord-docs-5) are described only as a one-way mechanism to post messages into channels, not as a way to subscribe to events; the platform's actual event-subscription mechanism is the Gateway API over WebSocket (discord-docs-10/20), not webhooks. No evidence shows an outbound webhook subscription system for receiving Discord events. Missing for 10: documentation of a webhook-based event subscription/callback system, examples of registering webhook endpoints for event delivery, and any independent confirmation of such a feature.
